title: Neutral Standing
description: Both players are standing, and neither has clearly won the grip, head position, or attacking angle.

title: Hand Fighting
description: A hand-and-head-position battle to enter an underhook, collar tie, snapdown, single leg, or Guard pull.

title: Closed Guard
description: The Guard player locks legs around the passer hips to control posture and set up submissions or sweeps.

title: Half Guard Bottom
description: The bottom player controls one of the top player’s legs but needs frames or an underhook to avoid being flattened.

title: Knee Shield Half Guard
description: The knee shield creates a wedge between the top player’s chest or hip and the bottom player’s body.

title: Seated Guard
description: The Guard player sits with shin frames, hand fighting, and wrestle-up or Guard-entry threats.

title: Supine Guard
description: The Guard player lies supine and uses feet, knees, frames, and hip angle to deny chest-to-chest passing.

title: Butterfly Guard
description: A Guard that uses butterfly hooks to elevate the opponent’s hips, force posts, and switch to sweeps or wrestle-ups.

title: Side Control Top
description: The top player holds Side Control with a crossface, underhook, hip block, and shoulder pressure.

title: Side Control Bottom
description: The bottom player is pinned chest-to-chest or controlled by a crossface and underhook, and must survive before escaping.

title: Mount Top
description: The top player sits over the opponent’s hips or chest, separates the elbows, and opens high Mount or submissions.

title: Mount Bottom
description: The bottom player is mounted and must protect the neck and arms while recovering the elbow-knee connection before high Mount develops.

title: Back Control
description: The attacker keeps chest-to-back connection, a seatbelt, and hooks or a body triangle to create strangle dilemmas.

title: Back Escape Position
description: The defender is escaping back control through hand fighting, shoulder-to-mat positioning, and hook clearing.

title: Headquarters Top
description: The top player stands in headquarters with one of the Guard player’s legs stapled and multiple passing lanes available.

title: Knee Cut Position
description: The top player cuts the knee across the thigh line while working to win the underhook or crossface and control the hip line.

title: Body Lock Passing Position
description: The top player locks low around the Guard player’s hips with chest-to-hip connection to clear the knee line.

title: Turtle Top
description: The top player rides turtle, hunting wrist control, hip pressure, mat returns, or back exposure.

title: Turtle Bottom
description: The bottom player in turtle must protect the neck, wrists, and back exposure while rebuilding a base.

title: Front Headlock Top
description: The top player controls the head and neck from the front, threatening a go-behind, Guillotine, or back take.

title: Front Headlock Bottom
description: The bottom player’s head and neck are pulled down, so they must protect the airway and rebuild their base.

title: Knee On Belly
description: The top player places a knee on the opponent belly or hip, creating pressure and quick transitions to pass, Mount, or submissions.

title: North South
description: The top player lies reverse from the head side, controlling chest-to-chest or chest-to-back with shoulder pressure.

title: De La Riva Guard
description: The Guard player uses a leg hook on the inside thigh and hand on the outside ankle to off-balance and sweep a standing passer.

title: Reverse De La Riva Guard
description: RDLR uses an outside thigh hook and hip rotation to create angle, sweep, or transition to other guards.

title: X-Guard
description: X-Guard uses foot on hip and leg wrap to off-balance and sweep from bottom, controlling the passer hip line.

title: Z-Guard (93 Guard)
description: Z-Guard is a deep knee-shield Half Guard using the shin and underhook to block crossface and set up wrestle-ups.

title: K-Guard
description: K-Guard controls one of the opponent legs with a shin frame and foot hook, creating angles into matrix, leg locks, or back takes.

title: Inverted Guard
description: The Guard player inverts to place feet on the hip line or shoulder line, creating sweep angles and leg entries.

title: Single Leg X
description: The Guard player controls one leg and the hip line to sweep, stand up, or enter ashi.

title: Outside Ashi
description: A leg entanglement with the leg outside the hip line, connected to Straight Ankle Locks and heel exposure.

title: Saddle / Inside Sankaku
description: A strong leg entanglement around the hip line and knee line, often carrying heel-hook danger when the heel is exposed.

title: Backside 50/50
description: A leg entanglement from behind where the attacker controls both the hip line and knee line, creating dangerous heel exposure from the rear.

title: Dogfight
description: Both players are on a knee or hip in an underhook-versus-whizzer battle from Half Guard or a wrestle-up.

title: Scramble Neutral
description: A transitional moment where neither player has clear control yet; the priorities are head position, hip control, inside position, and safety.

title: Crab Ride
description: The top player rides from below or behind with hooks behind the knees, pulling the opponent hips over to expose the back.

title: Cross-Wrist Ride
description: A ride from turtle/side where the attacker controls both wrists, stretching the opponent arms to expose the back.

title: Claw Ride
description: A ride combining deep underhook, head control, and hip pressure from turtle to expose the back or mat return.

title: Arm Triangle Threat
description: The attacker has moved the opponent’s arm across the neck line and is looking for shoulder pressure and angle to finish.

title: Rear Naked Choke Threat
description: The attacker from back control is opening a path under the chin through hand fighting and chest-to-back connection.
